sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: The official Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 checkpoint serves directly on a 950PR — no offline re-quantization and no --quantization ascend. vLLM Ascend reads quant_method: fp8 and weight_block_size straight from the checkpoint, expands the weight_scale_inv tiles at load time and re-quantizes to MXFP8 on 950.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B vs Gemma 4 12B: Which Local Model Wins? - orcarouter.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B versus Gemma 4 12B is not a fair fight yet, and it is worth keeping it that way in your head. One is a known quantity you can deploy this afternoon on modest hardware with a clean license; the other is the most interesting unmeasured local model of the year, pending weights, a license file, and a benchmark.
